about.heroSubtitle: Looking for a real home in a city that wasn't ours yet
about.storyOrigin: It started with a frustrating search. A founder relocated for work and faced the same choice everyone does: a tiny hotel room with no kitchen, or a 12-month lease on an empty apartment. Neither made sense. So we built a third option.
about.storyMission: In 2024, NEOS launched with a simple idea: beautiful, furnished apartments you can move into tomorrow. Every home is hand-picked, fully equipped, and located in neighborhoods where you'd actually want to live.
about.storyToday: Today, we're the go-to choice for professionals who need a real home, not a temporary fix. Tech leads, consultants, medical residents, relocating families — they all stay with us because we treat every stay like it matters. Because it does.
about.peopleFirstDesc: You're not a booking number. When you message us, a real person replies. We remember your coffee preference and your check-in quirks.
about.quality: If We Wouldn't Stay There, Neither Should You
about.qualityDesc: Our team visits every apartment. We test the WiFi, check the water pressure, and sit on the couch. Only the best make it to our platform.
about.flexibilityDesc: Projects get extended. Plans change. We get it. Flexible terms, easy extensions, no penalties for being human.
about.sustainabilityDesc: We partner with eco-conscious buildings, minimize waste, and choose local suppliers. Every city is our home too.
about.ctaSubtitle: Whether you're here for a month or a year, we'll make every city feel like yours.

faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about booking, payments, and your stay.
faqPage.teamHelp: Our team is here to help you 24/7.
faqPage.bq1: How do I make a reservation?
faqPage.ba1: Browse properties, select dates, click Reserve.
faqPage.bq3: Can I book for someone else?
faqPage.ba3: Yes, specify guest info during checkout.
faqPage.bq4: How do I know if my booking is confirmed?
faqPage.pq1: What payment methods do you accept?
faqPage.pa1: Major credit cards, Google Pay, bank transfers.
faqPage.sa3: Yes, flexible terms and centralized billing.
faqPage.b2bq1: What is the minimum stay duration?
faqPage.b2ba2: Flexible cancellation — free cancellation up to 30 days before move-in.
faqPage.b2bq3: Do you provide corporate invoice formats?
faqPage.b2ba3: Yes. We provide corporate invoices and support net-30 payment terms.
faqPage.b2ba4: Pet policy depends on the property and must be confirmed in advance.
faqPage.b2ba5: Some properties offer parking and it must be reserved separately.
faqPage.b2bq6: What insurance coverage do you carry?
faqPage.b2ba6: We carry $2M commercial general liability insurance.
faqPage.b2bq7: How does check-in and check-out work?
faqPage.b2ba7: Smart-lock self check-in is available, so no waiting is required.
faqPage.b2bq8: What is included in all-inclusive pricing?
faqPage.b2ba8: WiFi, utilities, housekeeping, linens/towels, and kitchen essentials are included.
